post_hoc_diagnostics_not_counted_as_pred.name: replay initial-failure diagnosis
post_hoc_diagnostics_not_counted_as_pred.result: audit harness omitted rtol in acceptance; no V5 output/call defect

tests.falsification: missing version root, unreadable file, unstable read, or incomplete path set
tests.method: lstat every path without following symlinks; SHA-256 every regular file; canonical aggregate over sorted records
tests.observed: Initial lstat/SHA-256 snapshot covered 3,612 regular files and 37 directories across v001-v004.
tests.title: Complete v001-v004 initial path/hash/stat snapshot

tests.falsification: performance-relevant change after first V5 outcome, irreconcilable ordering, or unexplained earlier outcome
tests.method: correlate states, ledgers, preregistrations, manifests, logs, decisions, hashes, filesystem times, and source diffs
tests.observed: v001 had 101 pre-outcome wrong-runtime failures and zero outcomes; v002/v003 failed preseal with zero outcomes; only v004 completed.
tests.title: Version and recovery chronology reconstruction

tests.falsification: unfrozen performance-relevant component or post-outcome selection
tests.method: map model, gate, normalization, compute price, stopping rule, analysis, and outcome mapping to seals/timestamps before execution
tests.observed: Scientific sources, model/gate/whitening artifacts, thresholds, analysis seeds, outcome mapping, and compute constants were hash-bound before raw V5.
tests.title: Pre-outcome freeze coverage

tests.falsification: unexplained launch, outcome, retry, or abandoned partial cohort
tests.method: enumerate version/recovery directories, logs, temporary artifacts, manifests, ledgers, and state transitions
tests.observed: No hidden/partial v004 raw artifacts or failure ledger; v004 contains exactly 1,600 NPZs and sidecars and no replacements.
tests.title: Partial launch and abandoned outcome search

tests.falsification: unreconciled source content/path/stat change during audit
tests.method: repeat COC-01 and exact-compare path set, content hashes, sizes, modes, and timestamps
tests.observed: Initial/final v001-v004 and full-program path, content, and stat records are exact; aggregate hashes are unchanged.
tests.title: Final canonical path/hash/stat stability

tests.falsification: any unexplained exact V5 membership in an earlier fitting/selection cohort
tests.method: extract V5 identifiers/seeds and compare with accessible training, discovery, calibration, qualification, and normalization cohorts excluding V3 test targets
tests.observed: No V5 ID or exact structured seed overlaps 31,629 accessible prior IDs or 28,427 accessible prior seeds.
tests.title: Exact identifier and seed overlap

tests.falsification: collision or reuse capable of reproducing a V5 episode
tests.method: reconstruct seed transforms and compare raw/base/derived seed tuples across accessible cohorts
tests.observed: No low-32-bit or SeedSequence-state transformed seed overlap.
tests.title: Transformed-seed and derivation overlap

tests.falsification: V5-equivalent raw episode or trajectory in an earlier fitting/selection cohort
tests.method: compare whole-file, array, initial-state, action, observation, and trajectory hashes where common fields exist
tests.observed: All 1,600 V5 raw archives and 2,472 accessible prior raw archives were fingerprinted; no state/action/observation/initial-pixel exact collision.
tests.title: Exact raw and trajectory fingerprint overlap

tests.falsification: unexplained cross-cohort near duplicate at a threshold consistent with causal equivalence
tests.method: quantized fingerprints and nearest-neighbor distances calibrated against within-cohort and synthetic perturbation distances
tests.observed: No cross-cohort state/action/observation/pixel sketch fell below the predeclared near-duplicate threshold.
tests.title: Near-duplicate state/action/observation search

tests.falsification: normalization, whitening, threshold, or qualification statistic derived from V5 outcomes/targets
tests.method: trace all fit statistics and qualification inputs to pre-V5 source cohorts and hashes
tests.observed: Fit/selection isolation is frozen pre-V5; runtime/canary audit found no confirmation-derived normalization or whitening input.
tests.title: No V5-derived normalization or qualification

tests.falsification: privileged/future field reaches gate or an input origin/timing is unresolved
tests.method: AST/text/manual trace from raw loader through feature transforms, score, threshold, and call
tests.observed: Static gate inputs are history, action history, current prediction, last update, and frozen stage parameters only.
tests.title: Static gate dataflow inventory

tests.falsification: runtime accesses an undeclared or privileged value
tests.method: instrument copied loader/mapping access and gate boundary to log keys, shapes, values' origins, and access order
tests.observed: Runtime tracing materialized only action and pixels.
tests.title: Runtime gate input access trace

tests.falsification: loader/gate observes, forwards, or reacts to any canary
tests.method: inject sentinel future_obs, target, loss, gain, contact, reward, done, success, oracle, and future_summary fields into copied inputs and independently perturb them
tests.observed: Twelve privileged canary families were never materialized and changing them left loader outputs invariant.
tests.title: Privileged canary rejection and invariance

tests.falsification: any feature is unavailable at the decision point or depends on future transitions
tests.method: document timestamp and causal availability for every scalar/tensor entering each decision
tests.observed: Every gate input is available at the decision; target latent appears only after routing for audit/analysis.
tests.title: Decision-time availability table

tests.falsification: missing or mismatched performance-relevant artifact
tests.method: independently hash models, solver exits, gate, fit, whitening, normalization, thresholds, runtime contract, and source against manifests/seals
tests.observed: All preseal, frozen-candidate, external-model, input-seal, and package-ready hash checks pass now under both declared runtimes.
tests.title: Frozen artifact hash verification

tests.falsification: executed implementation cannot be tied to sealed bytes or a substitution path exists
tests.method: correlate execution manifests/logs/runtime attestation with sealed source and loaded module paths
tests.observed: Sealed sources and stable frozen module-state digests are tied to exact full MPS replay; historical device is strongly inferred though not manifest-explicit.
tests.title: Executed-code provenance

tests.falsification: environment-dependent performance path or unrecorded dependency can change outputs
tests.method: static scan plus controlled environment perturbations on copied code
tests.observed: FAIL: runtime sealing does not hash the complete transitive Python/native/MPS dependency graph or loaded sys.modules/OS build. Exact replay bounds but does not retroactively attest the historical environment.
tests.title: Dynamic import, fallback, bytecode, and environment scan

tests.falsification: nondeterminism or implicit training/device branch changes decisions
tests.method: inspect and replay repeated copied inference under recorded conditions and safe alternative batching
tests.observed: Module state/gradients are unchanged and repeated packaged inference is exact for all 60,800 rows.
tests.title: Determinism, gradients, dtype, and device contract

tests.falsification: clean-room implementation disagrees with hand calculations
tests.method: hand-constructed fixtures covering exits, reachability, comparators, whitening, bootstrap, ranks, and outcome mapping
tests.observed: All hand/synthetic calls, mixture, quantile, rank, and Spearman fixtures pass.
tests.title: Synthetic clean-room harness validation

tests.falsification: verified discrepancy beyond preregistered tolerance
tests.method: independent float64 tensor arithmetic and aggregation without package analysis imports
tests.observed: Per-transition and per-episode errors independently agree within tolerance.
tests.title: Per-transition and per-episode error recomputation

tests.falsification: any Boolean call, reached-stage count, or histogram mismatch
tests.method: reapply frozen score thresholds and reachability rules independently
tests.observed: Calls, reached counts, histogram [50,973, 7,267, 1,773, 787], and threshold decisions reproduce exactly.
tests.title: Adaptive calls, stage reach, and histograms

tests.falsification: comparator value, call mapping, or information-set mismatch
tests.method: construct allowed comparator policies from frozen exit errors and exact costs
tests.observed: Fixed exits and every transition-independent comparator mapping reproduce.
tests.title: Fixed-exit and transition-independent comparator recomputation

tests.falsification: effect mismatch beyond tolerance or sign disagreement
tests.method: float64 independent aggregation from per-transition errors and frozen whitening constants
tests.observed: Raw and native-whitened effects and bounds reproduce to machine precision.
tests.title: Raw and native-whitened effect recomputation

tests.falsification: decision-critical interval/bound/rank mismatch beyond tolerance
tests.method: independent resample-index generation/aggregation, Bonferroni bounds, and deterministic average-rank statistics
tests.observed: All 20,000 bootstrap streams/quantiles, Bonferroni bounds, and stage ranks reproduce.
tests.title: Bootstrap, simultaneous bounds, and ranks

tests.falsification: claimed terminal label does not follow from frozen rule and recomputed values
tests.method: evaluate preregistered predicates independently from recomputed statistics
tests.observed: Recomputed predicates map exactly to v5_confirmation_passed.
tests.title: Terminal outcome mapping

tests.falsification: output/call mismatch beyond tolerance or material unreplayed surface
tests.method: replay frozen loader, solver exits, gate, and sparse execution from raw inputs for all 60,800 transitions
tests.observed: Complete packaged-path replay covers all 1,600 episodes/60,800 rows with exact targets, exits, sparse outputs, calls, scores, and features.
tests.title: Complete packaged-path replay

tests.falsification: persistent disagreement with preserved execution or packaged replay
tests.method: load frozen modules/artifacts through a separately batched path without package runner orchestration
tests.observed: Independent explicit sqrt/sum algebra is within audit tolerance with exact calls/outputs; a second vector_norm-order transcription is bit exact.
tests.title: Independent direct-module replay strategy

tests.falsification: row identity/order, output, or decision mismatch
tests.method: synthetic indexed rows plus real reached rows across batch sizes and permutations
tests.observed: Dense/sparse, forward_selected/manual sparse, row identity, and restoration are exact/within the sealed output contract.
tests.title: Dense versus sparse and row restoration equivalence

tests.falsification: unreached values affect calls, NaNs pass silently, or documented comparator/operator differs
tests.method: synthetic and real near-threshold probes around each exact threshold
tests.observed: Reached values are finite, unreached values NaN, calls are stable, and minimum active score margins are 2.50e-5, 8.82e-5, and 2.85e-5.
tests.title: NaN, unreached-stage, and threshold boundary behavior

tests.falsification: claimed total differs or overhead is omitted
tests.method: derive integer FLOPs from layer/tensor shapes and executed call counts including feature and gate overhead
tests.observed: FAIL: 4,332,936,120,435 is exactly reproduced under the inherited ledger, including 584,398,195 gate FLOPs, but it omits executed pixel encoding and visible bias/GELU/alpha/residual operations.
tests.title: Operation graph and exact FLOP derivation

tests.falsification: privileged transition information, wrong mixture, or rounding capable of reversing benefit
tests.method: derive transition-independent mixture from allowed aggregate call/compute information using exact rational bounds
tests.observed: Analytic comparator uses a global transition-independent d1/d2 mixture; weight 0.25295409752763076 reproduces exactly.
tests.title: Analytic comparator information and mixture fairness

tests.falsification: any claimed matched comparator uses less total compute
tests.method: exact integer recomputation for every seeded realization and total
tests.observed: Seeded comparator uses 4,332,936,224,000 declared FLOPs, exactly 103,565 more than adaptive.
tests.title: Seeded comparator weakly-more-compute proof

tests.falsification: wrong exit mapping, reachability, or episode allocation
tests.method: independently map every comparator call/histogram to exit outputs and costs
tests.observed: Call-count and within-episode histogram-to-exit mappings reproduce exactly.
tests.title: Call-count and within-episode histogram mapping

tests.falsification: count, membership, or row-accounting mismatch
tests.method: cross-check raw/execution manifests, arrays, IDs, row counts, and per-episode transition counts
tests.observed: Exactly 1,600 episodes × 38 rows = 60,800 transitions across manifests/arrays.
tests.title: Exact 1,600 episode and 60,800 transition cohort

tests.falsification: replacement, duplicate, omitted attempt, or unexplained missing episode
tests.method: reconstruct attempted generation and compare unique IDs/seeds/path sets across raw and execution evidence
tests.observed: All IDs, raw paths, raw hashes, and slots are unique; zero replacements.
tests.title: Zero replacements and unique identifiers

tests.falsification: recovery/exclusion/restart depends on observed model performance or decision
tests.method: trace recovery trigger, timing, inputs, and resumed cohort boundaries against preregistered rules
tests.observed: Recovery failures preceded outcomes and were runtime/preseal-rule based, not performance conditioned.
tests.title: Recovery rule independence from performance

tests.falsification: applicable preflight/final verifier reports success
tests.method: one-byte outcome corruption plus model and gate hash mismatches on independent copies
tests.observed: One-byte execution and gate corruptions are hash-rejected.
tests.title: Content and artifact hash corruptions fail closed

tests.falsification: applicable loader/verifier accepts corrupted cohort as confirmation
tests.method: missing raw, extra raw, duplicate ID, manifest mismatch, and reordered rows on independent copies
tests.observed: FAIL: missing/extra/hash mismatch reject, but existing-manifest preflight accepts duplicate ID metadata and semantic verifier accepts a consistently rebound row order.
tests.title: Path-set and identifier corruptions fail closed

tests.falsification: loader escapes root or verifier follows unapproved symlink
tests.method: independent-copy path traversal manifest and symlinked artifact substitution
tests.observed: FAIL: raw preflight accepts ../ root escape with a matching declared hash and final verifier follows a byte-identical external symlink.
tests.title: Traversal and symlink substitution fail closed

tests.falsification: applicable verifier still authenticates the original confirmation
tests.method: change one frozen threshold, compute price, and interpreter/runtime condition on copies
tests.observed: Threshold, compute-price, and wrong-interpreter mutations reject.
tests.title: Threshold, compute-price, and runtime changes fail closed

tests.falsification: unexpected privileged field is silently consumed or changes decision
tests.method: add sentinel privileged fields to copied raw input and exercise preflight/loader/gate
tests.observed: Post-manifest privileged fields reject; pre-manifest unknown fields are safely allowlist-ignored, not materialized, and leave outputs exact.
tests.title: Unexpected privileged input field fails closed

tests.falsification: real benefit is not in the favorable 5% tail or constraints fail
tests.method: 2,000 deterministic reachability-preserving permutations with master seed 510001
tests.observed: 2,000 within-episode/reachability permutations: raw/white p=0.00049975.
tests.title: Within-stratum score/decision permutation

tests.falsification: real benefit is not distinguishable at one-sided plus-one p<0.05 or matching fails
tests.method: 2,000 random policies (510002) and 2,000 mixed policies (510003) preserving total calls/compute and valid reachability
tests.observed: 2,000 random and 2,000 constant/mixed compute-matched policies: raw/white p=0.00049975.
tests.title: Random and constant/mixed matched-compute policies

tests.falsification: destroyed alignment retains a result at least as favorable with plus-one p>=0.05
tests.method: 2,000 deterministic episode or valid-transition-block permutations with master seed 510004
tests.observed: FAIL retained: 1,000 whole-episode target reassignments give raw p=0.164835 (white p=0.000999); second 1600×1600 implementation agrees.
tests.title: Target/block alignment permutation

tests.falsification: real allocation is not favorably distinguishable or reverse ordering improves equivalently
tests.method: 2,000 matched-compute association breaks (510005) and 2,000 reversals/perturbations (510006)
tests.observed: 2,000 score-gain breaks and 2,000 perturbed reversed orderings give raw/white p=0.00049975; deterministic reversal is worse.
tests.title: Broken score-gain association and ordering reversal

tests.falsification: any decision-critical output changes
tests.method: add and vary audit-only unused fields and require byte/semantic identity of all decision outputs
tests.observed: Two extreme unused-field values leave every semantic output digest exact.
tests.title: Unused output field invariance

tests.falsification: sign/decision changes or discrepancy exceeds declared floating tolerance without explanation
tests.method: original/reversed/shuffled order with float64, pairwise, Kahan, and math.fsum accumulation
tests.observed: Forward/reverse NumPy and math.fsum raw effects are identical.
tests.title: Aggregation and accumulation sensitivity

tests.falsification: scientific sign or preregistered decision is convention-fragile
tests.method: independent seeded indices and standard linear/lower/higher/midpoint quantile conventions
tests.observed: All standard bootstrap quantile conventions retain positive lower bounds.
tests.title: Bootstrap and quantile implementation sensitivity

tests.falsification: a very small subset can reverse the sign or dominates the scientific interpretation
tests.method: compute all leave-one-episode effects, influence bounds, and deterministic seed-block summaries
tests.observed: Every leave-one-episode-out effect is positive; all 100-episode block means are positive.
tests.title: Leave-one-episode and seed-block influence
